strings.en: Myth 1: You don't need sunscreen indoors

strings.zh: 迷思 2：陰天 / 下雨可以省防曬
strings.en: Myth 2: You can skip sunscreen on cloudy or rainy days

strings.zh: 迷思 3:SPF 越高效果越好
strings.en: Myth 3: Higher SPF is always better

strings.zh: 迷思 4：物理防曬一定比化學防曬好
strings.en: Myth 4: Physical sunscreen is always better than chemical sunscreen
Myth 5: Applying once a day is enough

strings.zh: 迷思 6：防曬乳一定會堵塞毛孔長痘
strings.en: Myth 6: Sunscreen always clogs pores and causes acne

strings.zh: 迷思 7：深膚色不會曬黑曬傷
strings.en: Myth 7: Darker skin doesn't tan or burn

strings.zh: 迷思 8：全身共用同一支防曬
strings.en: Myth 8: One sunscreen for face and body is fine
Bottom line — one sentence to remember

strings.zh: 常見問題（PTT / Dcard 上常被問的）
strings.en: Common Questions (frequently asked on PTT / Dcard)

strings.zh: 防曬乳 PTT / Dcard 推薦的牌子如何挑？
strings.en: How do I choose among the sunscreen brands recommended on PTT / Dcard?

strings.zh: 防曬 SPF 50 跟 SPF 30 差很多嗎？
strings.en: Is there a big difference between SPF 50 and SPF 30?

strings.zh: 物理性 vs 化學性防曬哪個好？
strings.en: Physical vs chemical sunscreen — which is better?
Do I need to use cleanser to remove sunscreen?
How should children and pregnant women choose sunscreen?

strings.zh: UV / 可見光 穿透皮膚深度
strings.en: UV / visible light penetration depth in skin

strings.zh: 紫外線分 UVA 與 UVB:
strings.en: UV light is divided into UVA and UVB:

strings.zh: 純室內坐辦公室的人不需要每幾小時補，但出去吃午餐前 / 下班前可以再補一次。
strings.en: If you stay strictly indoors at an office, you don't need to reapply every few hours — but reapplying before stepping out for lunch or after work is reasonable.

strings.zh: 美國皮膚科醫學會的觀察：
下水或大量流汗後立刻補擦
strings.en: Reapply immediately after swimming or heavy sweating

strings.zh: 換 gel 質地或 liquid 質地（別用厚重霜狀）
strings.en: Switch to gel or fluid textures (avoid heavy creams)

strings.zh: 選成分含 niacinamide / azelaic acid 的防曬
strings.en: Choose sunscreens that include niacinamide or azelaic acid
Remove sunscreen at night with proper cleansing

strings.zh: 有色防曬（含氧化鐵 iron oxide)
能穿透一般玻璃 50% 以上
可見光（尤其藍光與紫光）
UVA 穿透雲層的能力很強
使用習慣的影響遠大於 SPF 數字
strings.en: usage habits matter far more than the SPF number

strings.zh: 關鍵不是 SPF 數字，是「擦夠厚 + 規律補擦」
strings.en: The key isn't the SPF number — it's applying enough thickness and reapplying regularly

strings.zh: 未證實有任何健康危害
實際保護力降低 50% 以上
strings.en: actual protection drops by 50% or more

strings.zh: 防曬噴霧、棒狀防曬、防曬粉、防曬蜜粉
strings.en: sunscreen sprays, sticks, powders, and pressed-powder sunscreens

strings.zh: 仍會曬傷、皮膚癌、明顯加重肝斑與痘印
strings.en: still risk sunburn, skin cancer, and significantly worsened melasma and post-acne marks

strings.zh: 肝斑、痘印、發炎後色素沉澱
strings.en: melasma, post-acne marks, and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation

strings.zh: 每天擦、擦夠厚、規律補擦、SPF 30+ 廣譜防護
strings.en: Apply daily, apply enough, reapply regularly, SPF 30+ broad-spectrum

strings.zh: SPF 30 已擋掉 97% UVB,SPF 50 擋 98%
strings.en: SPF 30 already blocks 97% of UVB; SPF 50 blocks 98%

strings.zh: 室內、陰天、SPF、物理化學一次釐清
strings.en: Indoors, cloudy days, SPF, physical vs chemical — clarified at once
